slides.label: Toggle
headline: Mute your mic
from the menu bar
slides.body: Click or use a shortcut to toggle mute. Toggle again to restore the saved state.
slides.detail: Available controls depend on the input device.
slides.alt: Mutelet menu showing a muted microphone and the Unmute button

slides.label: Push to Talk
headline: Hold a shortcut
to unmute
slides.body: The mic is unmuted while you hold the shortcut and muted when you release it. The default shortcut is F8.
slides.detail: Toggle and Push to Talk can use separate shortcuts.
slides.alt: Mutelet menu explaining how to hold the shortcut to talk

slides.label: Status display
headline: See your
microphone status
slides.body: Show the microphone status after an action or keep the status indicator visible.
slides.detail: Adjust the display size and position.
slides.alt: Display settings for the on-screen HUD and persistent status
slides.accentAlt: On-screen HUD showing the microphone state

slides.label: Settings
headline: Choose a mode
and input
slides.body: Choose the system default input, a selected input, or all inputs.
slides.detail: Mutelet can open when you log in.
slides.alt: General settings for microphone mode, input target, and launch at login
